basis: The chart 'High fibre breakfast cereals vs Other breakfast cereals' shows the consumption values for the 11-18 years age group. The blue line, representing 'High fibre breakfast cereals', has a value of 18. The red dashed line, representing 'Other breakfast cereals', has a value of 6. Since the high-fibre category has a significantly higher value (18 vs 6), it is the appropriate category for escalation to adolescent fibre-support follow-up.
option_label: Route high-fibre breakfast cereals for 11-18 years to adolescent fibre-support follow-up
